summary: Nexus Advanced Technologies Inc. (formerly K Wave Media Ltd.), a Cayman Islands foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing an ATM Consent, Note Repayment and Warrant Exchange Agreement dated October 2, 2026 with Anson Investments Master Fund L.P. and Anson East Master Fund L.P. The Holder consents to ATM sales from the week of September 28, 2026 through March 31, 2027, with a $2.00 per share floor; the Company must remit 20% of net ATM proceeds toward its Senior Secured Convertible Notes due July 12, 2027. Existing warrants for 8,310,250 shares at $1.90 are amended for cashless exchange at a 0.5415 ratio, yielding 4,500,000 Exchange Shares, subject to a 15% daily volume limitation. Watch dilution and note-repayment pace.
